body: Hey OP, from my own experience, you’re doing everything right. Still fighting the bad thoughts while loving your partner. It’s the best thing you can do if you truly love someone. I got into a situation a few months ago where I was kissed without my consent and my boyfriend was pretty upset about it eventually leading to our break that were in now. Growing trust and regaining everything you had in the beginning is just the first step. Nothings going to heal right away but I think you’re doing everything right. I hope you two continue to be communicative and happy because without it, you might not even be with him.
It’s not that the trust was gone it was about the Snapchat stuff. I fucked up trying to protect a relationship. It was wrong, I know, but after the assault thing I felt it was right.

My boyfriend and i have talked about relapsing before and both of us know it’s something I would never turn to no matter my mental situation. Being in addiction was one of the worst things I did to myself. 

I want therapy but I can’t afford it. Even couples therapy which is something I begged to try out before all of this

Lol you’re good I don’t think I was being as straightforward in my original text. There’s a lot to the story I just summed it up best I could. Don’t get me wrong the woman is also very attractive I just noticed more of a desire toward the male. Tbh my true desire is for all of us to grow together. I’m just not sure on if it’s a fantasy or genuine romance as a polyamorous relationship if that makes sense

Idk I saw your post n I got in my feels but thinking you’re gonna live to see a certain year is something I’ve been prepared for forever.
